response.sql: WITH rating_rentals AS (SELECT f.rating, COUNT(r.rental_id) as rental_count FROM rental r JOIN inventory i ON r.inventory_id = i.inventory_id JOIN film f ON i.film_id = f.film_id GROUP BY f.rating), overall_avg AS (SELECT AVG(rental_count) as avg_all FROM rating_rentals) SELECT AVG(rr.rental_count) as average_figure, AVG(rr.rental_count) - oa.avg_all as how_far_above FROM rating_rentals rr, overall_avg oa WHERE rr.rental_count > oa.avg_all
